reviewer: AI (Claude) independent reviewers (blind solve + informed review), separate from the author; not a native-speaker or teacher review

bad: We talked about that we should move to a bigger house.
We talked about whether should we move to a bigger house.
We talked about whether we should to move to a bigger house.
set.rule: 전치사 뒤에서 ‘~인지 아닌지’의 명사절은 whether로 이끌어요. that절은 전치사의 목적어가 될 수 없고, 절 안은 「주어 + should + 동사원형」 순서예요.

patches.why: Remove disputable if distractor; rule no longer claims if is wrong.

bad: It doesn't matter whether does it rain tomorrow.
It doesn't matter whether it will rains tomorrow.
It doesn't matter whether it rain tomorrow.

patches.why: Replace arguable "if or not" distractor with a clearly wrong form.

bad: Please tell me which does bus go to the airport.
Please tell me which bus going to the airport.
Please tell me which bus go to the airport.

patches.why: Emphatic "does go" is grammatical; replace with inverted order.

set.rule: 의문사가 이끄는 명사절은 평서문 어순(주어 + 동사)이에요. where 자체가 ‘어디에’라는 장소 부사이므로 there를 덧붙이지 않아요.

criteria: single defensible answer (blind solve), natural English, level, distractor validity, hint and explanation
